title: Ring-sheaf adjoint from homogeneous formulas
statement: Let i:Z→X and i′:Z′→X′ be closed immersions with conormal presentations A,A′ [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra], and let i≫g=f≫i′. Any module-sheaf map q:A′→f_*A which, on compatible ambient affine pairs, sends each homogeneous ideal-power representative to the class of a representative whose inclusion is its image under g-sharp, induces a ring-sheaf morphism A′→f_*A. Its underlying section functions equal those of q and it is compatible with the structure-sheaf maps.

source.place: Divisors Tag 0634, affine algebra-law check and sheaf locality

proof.text: On compatible affine charts, the homogeneous representative formula implies preservation of one and products by the homogeneous ring-map theorem. For an arbitrary open V⊆Z′, use that i′ is a closed embedding to find ambient opens inducing V; compatible pairs of ambient affine subopens cover f⁻¹V. Naturality and sheaf locality extend the ring laws to V. Package the additive section maps as ring homomorphisms. Their naturality defines a morphism of ring sheaves. The linearity of q applied to r times one and its unit law prove compatibility with the structure sheaves.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_ringAdjoint_of_homogeneousFormula {X Z X' Z' : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (i' : Z' ⟶ X') [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (g : X ⟶ X') (f : Z ⟶ Z') (h : i ≫ g = f ≫ i')
    (A : Presentation i) (A' : Presentation i')
    (q : A'.algebra.toModule ⟶ (pushforward f).obj A.algebra.toModule)
    (hq : ∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (U' : X'.affineOpens)
      (H : U.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) (Hf : i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (i' ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1))
      (n : ℕ) (a : (power i' n).val.obj (op U'.1)),
      ∃ b : (power i n).val.obj (op U.1),
        (powerInclusion i n).app U.1 b =
          g.appLE U'.1 U.1 H ((powerInclusion i' n).app U'.1 a) ∧
        A.algebra.right.obj.map (homOfLE Hf).op
          (q.val.app (op (i' ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1))
            (homogeneousClass i' A'.algebra A'.inclusion n U'.1 a)) =
          homogeneousClass i A.algebra A.inclusion n U.1 b) :
    ∃ ρ : A'.algebra.right ⟶
        (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} f.base).obj A.algebra.right,
      (A'.algebra.hom ≫ ρ =
        (⟨f.c⟩ : Z'.sheaf ⟶
          (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} f.base).obj Z.sheaf) ≫
          (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} f.base).map A.algebra.hom) ∧
      ∀ (V : Z'.Opens) (a : A'.algebra.right.obj.obj (op V)),
        q.val.app (op V) a = ρ.hom.app (op V) a
